segments.text: what's new in Shopify in 2024 release Wave 2 the Shopify connector allows you to synchronize data such as items inventory and customers between Shopify and business Central and helps you manage your online store Shopify allows you to add customer fields or meta fields to main entities like products or variants

now you can import or export meta Fields linked to products or variants in Shopify and use them to do custom mappings you you can also synchronize translations with a new languages action just import languages from Shopify and add them to items in business Central your Shopify store then has the option to change the language

of product descriptions so you can stay competitive in different markets with Shopify you can use company cataloges and business Central to synchronize company specific prices and discounts this ensures that each company sees their negotiated prices and discounts when they log into your Shopify store you can also assign specific discounts to individual

customers in business Central and then create customer specific orders in Shopify ensuring personalized pricing you can now map shipping fee information from Shopify to business Central more accurately and with more flexibility when you synchronize data with Shopify choose from different types of shipping charges such as item or

item charge and specify the shipping agent and shipping agent service you can then make sales orders with business Central and see see the shipping charges and shipment methods such as agent and agent service directly in your sales documents we've also added a new way to reconcile transactions with different payment methods like gift cards and credit cards

you can now post receipt journals and then reconcile your transactions directly in business Central and finally you can now easily synchronize posted sales invoices to Shopify you can use the filters and select to post the invoices for specific customers and companies you can then see the orders in Shopify and
see the details of all their orders like the payment and fulfillment status thank you for watching
